name: olacheap
description: OlaCheap: domains, business email, hosting and VPS. Connects to the OlaCheap MCP server, which requires sign-in with an OlaCheap account or a personal API key.

interface.shortDescription: OlaCheap MCP server for domains, business email, hosting and VPS
interface.longDescription: Connects to the OlaCheap MCP server (https://olacheap.com/api/mcp). The server requires sign-in with an OlaCheap account (OAuth) or a personal API key. The tools are listed by the server after sign-in.
